_comment: Synthetic payer policy data for demo purposes only. Shaped so it maps 1:1 onto a future BigQuery table `payer_policy.cpt_rules` (partition key: cpt_code) and `payer_policy.member_eligibility` (partition key: payer_id). No real PHI, payer, or policy content.
